title: Directional derivatives of test forms are test forms
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, let φ be a differential q-form on ℝ^P (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) q) that is a test form (IsTestForm φ: φ is C^∞ and has compact support), and let v ∈ ℝ^P. Then the q-form z ↦ Dφ(z)[v] := fderiv ℝ φ z v is again a test form.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) q) (v : Euclid P), IsTestForm φ → IsTestForm (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ z v)
